name: Hoshikage no Diamond ~Timeless Soul~
original_name: 星影のダイヤモンド～Timeless Soul～
source:
The world is going to explode in 5 minutes from a meteorite impact!
You must acquire the 5 holy clothes (underpants) of the Holy Beast, and use their pheromone power to save Earth!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ309677.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
